intro: You are in Pompeiopolis, an ancient city in Kastamonu province from the 1st century BC. It was the Roman capital of Paphlagonia, and its mosaics earned it the name 'Zeugma of the Black Sea'.
history: Pompey founded the city as the regional capital. Excavations here have revealed a Domus villa with rich mosaic floors.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the Domus villa and the mosaics, then the bath complex and the colonnaded building.
facts: Did you know? The city is named after Pompey the Great, who reorganised the region in 64 BC. He founded it after clearing the Black Sea of pirates, and it became the capital of Paphlagonia. Its colonnaded street and mosaic villa floors show how far Roman luxury reached, even into provincial towns.
outro: This brings our tour of Pompeiopolis to an end. Please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Thank you for listening, and enjoy your visit.
